q7.answer: I never decided how workers learn that the mode changed, such as polling or push from the config service. I also did not decide what happens to an invoice being processed during a forward move. I only decided the rollback flip case: the new engine's in-progress work is dropped, its ledger entries stay, and the shared charge key stops double charges.

q8.answer: The evidence is the rollout record. The nightly job writes each day's mismatch rate and invoices compared there, and the controller keeps the day counts, the Finance sign-off and any unresolved mismatches. The controller is the only writer of billing_mode. It accepts one step forward, only from a person, and only if the gate is met, and it rejects anything else.

q9.answer: The rollout controller detects it. It measures the new engine's charge failure rate over any 10-minute window, in both or new_only only, from provider responses. When the rate is above 2% it starts the rollback and pages on-call. The exact definition of a failure and the minimum number of charges are open questions.

q10.answer: Nothing is queued. While charging is frozen, periods that come due are not charged. Reconcile finds them later as invoiced periods with no charged entry. After the flip to old_only, the old engine charges the stored list first, then carries on with normal runs. Customers may be billed late but not twice.

q11.answer: One idempotency charge key per customer and billing period is used at both the ledger and the payment provider, and both engines share it. Settle looks up every pending entry at the provider before anything else. Reconcile counts a period as due only if it has no charged entry under its key. The old engine also skips any period already charged.

q12.answer: Billing stays at the failed step. The flag still shows both or new_only, charging stays frozen, and nothing is flipped. The rollout record holds the current step and the mode the rollback started from. The controller retries that step and pages on-call, and once it succeeds it moves on. If the old engine crashes after the flip, it restarts and works through what is left on the list.
